in_latin.meaning: Nomen femininum significans vincere, victoria, virtus.
in_latin.long_meaning: Vincenza est nomen femininum quod significat vincere, victoria, virtus. Originem trahit ex verbo vincere, quod significat triumphantem, victorem. historical_references.reference: Vincenza Giustiniani, an Italian noblewoman born in Perugia around 1511. She was a patroness of the arts and a key figure in the development of the High Renaissance in Central Italy. Vincenza supported artists such as Raphael, Perino del Vaga, and Giulio Romano.

Saint Vincenza Gerosa, an Italian nun born in Lovere in 1794. She founded the Congregation of the Daughters of Mary Help of the Christians, also known as the Salesian Sisters. Vincenza devoted her life to caring for the poor and education, and was canonized in 1940.
